extracted.intended_audience: Applicants, representatives, receiving national industrial property offices, and ARIPO Office staff involved in filing and processing ARIPO patent and industrial design applications
extracted.subtask_description: Filling, transmitting and responding to ARIPO (Harare Protocol) forms for patents, utility models and industrial designs, including required attachments, deadlines, signatures and inter-office communications. Covers notifications, invitations to correct, transmittals, certificates, withdrawals, conversions and recordation of rights under the Protocol.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal (ARIPO Form No. 24) — send with required accompanying documents
rubrics_metrics.description: A transmittal Form No. 24, with the required accompanying documents, shall be sent to the industrial property office of each designated State specified by the applicant on ARIPO Form No. 23/38 in connection with the above-identified application or to the applicant/representative. A copy of one of the Forms No. 24 thus transmitted shall also be sent to the applicant’s representative, without the accompanying documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate all industrial property offices (by name and State) to which a transmittal Form No. 24 with accompanying documents is being sent. Indicate the type of conversion where applicable. Type name of Director General under signature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Front page bibliographic data requirements (ARIPO Form No. 25)
rubrics_metrics.description: Bibliographic data for ARIPO patent front page: Application No.; Filing date; Priority; Publication No.; Int. Cl.; Owner(s) (Name, Address); Inventor(s) (Name, Address); Date of publication of ARIPO patent; Representative (Name, Address); Effective date of grant of ARIPO patent; Documents/Reference cited of prior art; Designated Contracting States for which patent is granted; Title; Abstract (with the most illustrative drawing, if there are any).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The description and claims are attached hereto and form an integral part hereof. Drawings, if any, should be attached and form an integral part. The numbers in parentheses are INID codes per WIPO Standard ST.9; include them as applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of grant contents (ARIPO Form No. 26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certificate must state patent number, name and address of grantee, date of grant, designated Contracting States in which the patent has effect, filing date and priority date, and identify the invention (title).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certificate must be dated and signed by Director General (type name under signature). Ensure filing and priority dates are correctly quoted and that the certificate shows the designated States in which the grant has effect.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of amendments by applicant(s) (ARIPO Form No. 27)
rubrics_metrics.description: When acknowledging ARIPO Form No. 22 (from the Office regarding Grant/Registration), the applicant must advise that Applicant has submitted [documents] to comply with the relevant statutory provisions and attach a copy of the submitted documents for consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include applicant’s name and address, application/patent/utility model number as appropriate, attach the submitted documents, and request a timely response to enable further processing. Type name of Director General under signature on the Office acknowledgement copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for registration of industrial design — required applicant and application particulars (ARIPO Form No. 28)
rubrics_metrics.description: Request must include: Title of industrial design; Applicant(s) (name, address, nationality, country of residence or principal place of business, telephone, telegraphic address); Representative (name, address, telephone); Designation of States; Creator information or statement that creator is applicant; Nature of industrial design (two-dimensional or three-dimensional); Priority declaration data (country, filing date, application no.), and supplemental box for overflow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a representative is appointed, the power of attorney on ARIPO Form No. 4 must be filed within 2 months from the filing of this Form. If the creator is not the applicant, a statement specifying the basis of the applicant’s right to registration must accompany the Form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority document and translation timing (ARIPO Form No. 28)
rubrics_metrics.description: If priority is claimed, the certified copy of the earlier application either accompanies the Form or will be furnished within 3 months from filing; the English translation of the earlier application either accompanies the Form or will be furnished within 6 months from filing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Mark the choice boxes accordingly; failure to supply certified copy or translation within these timeframes may affect priority claim. Use the supplemental box if additional priority entries are required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Checklist of documents with filing (ARIPO Form No. 28)
rubrics_metrics.description: This Form, as filed, must be accompanied by checked items from the checklist: separate signed power of attorney on ARIPO Form No.4; graphic reproduction(s); statement specifying the basis of the applicant’s right to registration; priority documents (certified copy of earlier application(s)); English translation of earlier application(s) on which priority is based; receipt for the fees paid; undertaking to pay the prescribed fees within 21 days; other documents (specify).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If any checklist box is unchecked, ensure the missing document is filed within the required period. Use supplemental box for additional information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation to correct by receiving Office (ARIPO Form No. 29) — scope and deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: After examining whether the application on its face fulfills the requirements of Section 4(1)(i) and (ii), the receiving Office may find that the application does not fulfill such requirements with respect to the identity of the applicant(s) or the reproduction of the industrial design, or that the application does not comply with Instruction 26(1), and request the applicant to file corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The invitation must specify the deficiency and request that the applicant, within 2 months from the date of the invitation, either file the correction together with payment of the prescribed fee, or request the Office to transmit all documents making up the application to the ARIPO Office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal by receiving Office to ARIPO — required verifications and document handling (ARIPO Form No. 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Receiving Office transmits documents making up the application in (n) copies (except certified copy of earlier application and translations which are transmitted in one copy). The receiving Office must indicate whether it verified that the application on the face of it fulfilled Section 4(1)(i) and (ii) on a specified date (receipt or date corrections received), or that it did not but the applicant requested transmission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The receiving Office should verify undertaking with respect to fees (submitted or paid and receipt issued), mark each document with actual date of its receipt, an appropriate number and official stamp, and issue to the applicant’s representative an acknowledgement of receipt on ARIPO Form No.8 (attach copy). Cite Instruction 26(1) where relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of transmittal to applicant (ARIPO Form No. 31)
rubrics_metrics.description: The receiving Office must notify the applicant(s), pursuant to Instruction 63, that the documents making up the application have been transmitted to the ARIPO Office on a specified date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include applicant name and address, application numbers given by both receiving and ARIPO Offices where known, and type name/title under signature. Send to applicant’s representative and to industrial property office of each designated State as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation by ARIPO to correct application (ARIPO Form No. 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: After examining pursuant to Instruction 65 (face of it requirements) and Instruction 66(1) (formal requirements), ARIPO may find that the application on the face of it does not fulfill requirements with respect to identity of applicant(s), reproduction of the industrial design or does not fulfill prescribed formal requirements, and thereby request corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ARIPO must request that the applicant(s), within 2 months from the date of the invitation, file the specified correction together with payment of the prescribed fee. If applicant has not been notified of ARIPO application no./filing date yet, different quoting rules apply (see footnote).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of filing date (ARIPO Form No. 33)
rubrics_metrics.description: ARIPO must notify the applicant that the above-identified application has been accorded (date) as its filing date. The Form includes the application number given by ARIPO Office and by the receiving Office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.33 shall be sent to the applicant’s representative and to the industrial property office of each designated State. Applicants should quote the application number given by ARIPO in all subsequent communications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification that application complies with formal requirements and payment request (ARIPO Form No. 34)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to Instruction 66(2), ARIPO notifies that the application complies with prescribed formal requirements, may attach a copy of the application, and requests the applicant(s) to make payment of the registration and publication fee within a specified period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inform applicant that before expiration of six months from the date of this notification each designated State may make a written communication on ARIPO Form No.37 to the effect that registration shall have no effect in its territory for reasons in Section 4(3). Upon expiration of the six months and subject to payment, ARIPO will register the industrial design and registration will have effect in designated States which have not made the said communication (see Instruction 70). Send notification to applicant’s representative and industrial property offices of designated States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of decision refusing application for non-compliance with formal requirements (ARIPO Form No. 35)
rubrics_metrics.description: ARIPO notifies the applicant that it has decided to refuse the application on grounds of non-compliance with prescribed formal requirements because the applicant failed to respond to an invitation to correct, or despite corrections the application still does not comply; the notification should state the reasons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advise applicant that, according to Section 4(5) and Instruction 69, the applicant may, within 3 months from the date of this notification, request on ARIPO Form No.38 that the application be treated, in any designated State, as an application according to the national law of that State. Send copies to applicant’s representative, the receiving Office and the industrial property office of each designated State that received Form No.33.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration of withdrawal and reduction of designated States (ARIPO Form No. 36)
rubrics_metrics.description: Declaration must identify the application/industrial design number, the person(s) requesting withdrawal (name, capacity, address), and state whether the application/registration has been marked withdrawn or endorsed with a reduction of designated States (listing states to which designations have been reduced).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pursuant to Instruction 67 (by reference to Instruction 47(1)), a declaration of withdrawal must be signed by the applicant or by all applicants if there are more than one. Type names under signatures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication by designated State that registration shall have no effect in its territory (ARIPO Form No. 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: A designated State may communicate, pursuant to Section 4(3), that if ARIPO registers the industrial design the registration shall have no effect in its territory because: (a) the industrial design is not new (reasons cited); (b) given the nature of the industrial design it cannot be registered / registration has no effect under that State’s law (cite relevant statutory provisions and attach copies); or (c) the industrial design is a textile design subject to a special register.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Communications should state the application number, applicant, filing date, the designated State on whose behalf the communication is sent, and provide detailed reasons and statutory citations. Note that, according to Rule 18quater(2)(b), the applicant may within 3 months request through ARIPO that the designated State reconsider the decision.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant response options to a designated State’s negative communication (ARIPO Form No. 37A)
rubrics_metrics.description: In response to a notification that registration shall have no effect in a designated State, the applicant may: accept the decision and withdraw the State (attach Form 36); convert the application to a national application (attach Form 38); or request the designated State to reconsider its decision based on attached documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The applicant must indicate which option is chosen and attach the relevant forms or supporting documents. Type name and title under signature. Timeliness and completeness of attachments are important for processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication of acceptance by designated State after reconsideration (ARIPO Form No. 37B)
rubrics_metrics.description: A designated State that reconsiders and accepts the application must communicate to the ARIPO Office that the above-identified application has been accepted with respect to the territory of that designated State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include application and filing dates, identify the designated State and signatory (name/title), and send to ARIPO. This permits registration to have effect in that designated State.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request for conversion into national application (ARIPO Form No. 38)
rubrics_metrics.description: If ARIPO has refused the application, the applicant may request, pursuant to Section 4(5), that the application be treated in each specified designated State as an application according to the national law of that State and request that ARIPO transmit the documents required by Rule 19(2) and Instruction 54(2) to each designated State’s industrial property office.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The request should identify the filing date and application number, list the designated States for conversion, and ARIPO must transmit the documents within 2 weeks of receiving this request. Attach a copy of ARIPO Form No.35 (refusal) per the Form instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of registration of industrial design contents (ARIPO Form No. 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Certificate must state registration number, name and address of registrant, date of registration, designated Contracting States in which registration has effect, filing date, priority date, title of industrial design, identity of creator (name and address), and be accompanied by a copy of the reproduction of the industrial design.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Certificate must be dated and signed by the Director General (type name under signature). Ensure reproduction copy is attached to the certificate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification by designated State of registration of licence/assignment/transmission or other right (ARIPO Form No. 40)
rubrics_metrics.description: Designated State must notify ARIPO, pursuant to Rule 22(3), when a licence, assignment, transmission or other similar right pertaining to an ARIPO-filed patent/utility model/industrial design application or registration has been registered under national law and provide particulars and copies of items/particulars recorded.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form must indicate which kind of matter (application, patent, registration, and relevant numbers and dates), give particulars of the recorded right, and attach copies of registered documents as required by national law. Type name and title under signature and identify the industrial property office and State.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application to register assignment, transmission or transfer (ARIPO Form No. 41) — initiation of recordal process
rubrics_metrics.description: (Form begins) Application to register assignment, transmission or other form of transfer must be submitted to the ARIPO Office (Rule 22(5); Instruction 73) identifying the matter (application/patent/utility model/industrial design) and providing applicant’s or representative’s file reference and particulars required for recordal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Although the chunk cuts off Form No.41 content, follow Instruction 73 and Rule 22(5): ensure proper identification of the subject matter, provide supporting documents (e.g., assignment agreements), and comply with national recording requirements when transmittal to ARIPO is requested.
